integrity: Both primary preprints were inspected in full at the exact smoothing-defect and perturbation inequalities used by the proof. The new claim changes only the limiting comparison of those two coefficients; the remaining collar, nesting, and exhaustion steps were checked not to require little-Hölder decay. No numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The endpoint threshold is sufficient and proof-generated, not claimed sharp. It covers small critical normal Hölder seminorms but not arbitrary C^{1,1/2} boundaries. The constant depends on the smoothing estimate and on the containing radius used by the quadratic perturbation.
title: A small critical-Hölder endpoint for strongly linearly convex exhaustion
